title: Reactive carbon capture using saline water: evaluation of prospective sources, processes, and products
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00701H, Review Article
Anya Dickinson-Cove, Erika La Plante, Yiming Liu, Dante Simonetti, Eric M. V. Hoek, Gaurav Sant, David Jassby
This review synthesizes the state of development of saline water-based reactive carbon capture, assessing how sources, processes, and products impact viability.
